question: What universal nature belongs to all beings as pervading self-awareness?
premises: All beings are pervading in nature.
All beings are likewise characterized without exception.
All beings are identical with self-awareness.
inference: Therefore, every being is universally pervading and essentially constituted as self-awareness.
uncertainties: Whether sarve and sarva qualify the same subject or function distributively is contextually inferred.
plain_english: And likewise, all are pervading; indeed, all are nothing but self-awareness.
